source.title: What Is a Cognitive Map? Organizing Knowledge for Flexible Behavior.

confidence_rationale: Strong source, but mapping fidelity is the limiting term. The review establishes that a single CODING SCHEME (relational, map-like) recurs across spatial and non-spatial domains; ARC-121 asserts something stronger and different -- that distinct mechanisms read and update one shared OBJECT INSTANCE. Shared format is evidence for, but not equivalent to, shared object; confidence set in the moderate band to reflect that gap rather than the paper's quality.
failure_signatures: Common coding format across domains is compatible with many mechanism-private instances of that format; the review does not establish that one instance is jointly maintained, which is the specific content of ARC-121.
The non-spatial evidence surveyed is substantially thinner and more recent than the spatial evidence, so the generalisation is a research programme the authors advocate rather than a settled finding.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Map-like representations observed in spatial contexts 'may be an instance of general coding mechanisms capable of organizing knowledge of all kinds', with common principles unifying apparently disparate spatial and non-spatial functions.
mapping.ree_translation: REE's mechanisms should be expected to converge on one representational FORMAT for the epistemic relationship (relational structure over entities), rather than each inventing a bespoke encoding -- the weaker, format-level half of ARC-121's convergence assertion.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is the load-bearing caveat for the whole pull: the review supports shared FORMAT, ARC-121 asserts shared OBJECT. A federation of mechanisms could each hold a private relational map and satisfy every finding reviewed here while falsifying ARC-121 in its stated design sense. Additionally the review is a synthesis and advocacy piece, not primary data.
mapping.source_context: Review of rodent and human electrophysiology, fMRI and computational modelling spanning spatial navigation, conceptual/social spaces, and artificial agents.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high (Neuron; authors are principals of the literature reviewed) but discounted from 0.9 because a review inherits its evidence rather than adding any. Mapping fidelity deliberately mid-band: the format-versus-instance distinction is exactly where a careless read would over-credit ARC-121.
